thread.title: Apple stock gains after report of three new iPhones

author: morningstar.com
title: Apple stock gains after report of three new iPhones
text:
Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) are up 0.9% in midday trading Monday after Bloomberg published a report (https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-08-27/apple-to-embrace-iphone-x-design-with-new-colors-bigger-screens) regarding Apple's plans for its next batch of iPhones. The piece said that Apple plans to launch three new phones this fall, a common expectation (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/heres-what-could-happen-to-apples-average-selling-prices-in-the-next-iphone-cycle-2018-06-22), and that the company will look to generate buzz for its new low-end model through a variety of color choices. This cheaper device will look like the iPhone X but have aluminum edges rather than steel ones, according to the report, and feature an LCD screen. The current iPhone X has an OLED screen, and many expect Apple to debut two higher-end models in the fall that feature OLED screens. One of these models will have a 5.8-inch screen and feature processing and camera upgrades, while the other will be have a 6.5-inch screen, Bloomberg said. It will reportedly let users view apps side by side. The report cites multiple anonymous sources. Apple shares are up 37% over the past 12 months, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average has gained 19%.
-Emily Bary; 1204ET
